newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden Riksbank says crown speculation not good.
newsitem.headline: Sweden Riksbank says crown speculation not good.

text.p: Sweden's central bank governor Urban Backstrom said on Friday that it was not good to have international speculators active in crown trade, as currently.
"It is not good to have international speculators in the crown on the market, as we now have," Backstrom said ahead of a seminar about Europe's economic and monetary union (EMU).
Backstrom pointed to that economic fundamentals are very strong in Sweden at the moment.
"We have a floating exchange rate with an inflation target and economic fundamentals -- with for example low inflation -- are strong at the moment," he said.
The Riksbank targets inflation of 2.0 percent with an allowed deviation of one percentage point on either side.
Swedish year-on-year inflation was -0.4 percent in February.
